title: Aurora, the Day-Spring
author: Jakob Bohme (Sparrow trans)
description: Jakob Bohme's early mystical work explores creation, divine life and the relationship between light and darkness. Its symbolic account of nature and spirit introduces themes developed throughout his later Christian theosophy.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/aurorathatisdays00bhme).
